customManagers.description: Track 1Password's stable Linux build into UPSTREAM_VERSION (the release name; the container floats to latest at first launch). 1Password publishes no release feed Renovate can read, but its apt repository -- the one 1password.conf's APT_REPO installs from -- indexes the current build.
clang22, the compiler the Sparkle updater is built with (build/build-updater.sh); one bare release tag. A bump rebuilds the updater in CI; it ships with the next release.
